versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: delivery-is-fast
kind: property
text:
  - Envoy delivers a message to a connected session in less than one second.

---
type: check
id: production-delivery-takes-under-a-second
serves: delivery-is-fast
subject: production
procedure: query
claim: Each delivery of the last hour took less than one second.
procedure_text:
  - The query reads the time of each delivery of the last hour.
  - It returns each delivery that took one second or more.
failing_example:
  - A copy of the delivery records with one delivery that took two seconds.

---
type: requirement
id: messages-reach-sessions
kind: behavior
text:
  - Envoy delivers each message to the session that it is for.

---
type: requirement
id: a-stored-message-survives-a-restart
kind: behavior
parent: messages-reach-sessions
text:
  - Envoy delivers each stored message to its session after the listener starts again.

---
type: check
id: a-restart-loses-no-message
serves: a-stored-message-survives-a-restart
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestARestartLosesNoMessage
  job: go-checks
claim: A message that the listener stores before a restart reaches its session after the restart.
procedure_text:
  - The program stores one message, starts the listener again and reads the messages of the session.
  - It must find the message one time.
failing_example:
  - A listener that deletes its stored messages when it starts.
